subject: Emerald Analytics - onboarding & VAT / invoice instructions
messages:
From: Aoife Murphy <aoife@emeraldanalytics.ie>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Onboarding - bank details and invoice routing

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — glad to get moving with Redwood. To kick off supplier onboarding, can you confirm the PO format and the billing address we should use on invoices? We operate from Ireland (Emerald Analytics Ltd) and will need to provide a VAT certificate if requested.

Key details from our side:
- Company: Emerald Analytics Ltd
- Registered address: 14 Merrion Square, Dublin 2, Ireland
- Billing contact: billing@emeraldanalytics.ie

We can send our VAT registration certificate and sample invoice once you confirm where to send them and whether Redwood expects VAT on the invoice or to apply reverse charge.

Thanks,
Aoife Murphy
Head of Finance
Emerald Analytics Ltd
Attachment: none in this message
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Aoife Murphy <aoife@emeraldanalytics.ie>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding - bank details and invoice routing

Hi Aoife — great to hear. Welcome aboard. A few quick items so we can set you up in our procurement system and issue PO 4532: 

1) Please send your Irish VAT registration number and a copy of the VAT certificate (pdf).
2) Confirm whether Emerald charges Irish VAT on outbound invoices to Redwood or if you expect reverse charge treatment (i.e., invoice without VAT, buyer accounts for VAT).
3) Provide the invoice sample you intend to use and your preferred remittance/bank details.

For our side: PO 4532 will reference Redwood Inference EMEA Billing and should be sent to billing@emeraldanalytics.ie in PDF. Our finance team (cc'd) will confirm invoice fields we require for EU suppliers (PO number, VAT numbers for both parties, invoice date, invoice number, net/gross line items).

If you prefer, you can upload documents to the DocuSign/Drive link below, or just reply with attachments.

Doc link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/po/DEAL-8342

Thanks — I’ll loop in Finance for any tax specifics.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aoife Murphy <aoife@emeraldanalytics.ie>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Declan O'Sullivan <declan@emeraldanalytics.ie>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding - bank details and invoice routing

Hi Dylan (and team),

Thanks — see VAT details below and attached certificate.

- VAT number: IE6524937FH
- VAT certificate: attached (emerald_vat_certificate_2026.pdf)
- Bank details: Bank of Ireland, IBAN: IE29BOFI909424... 
- Invoice sample attached: emerald_invoice_sample_4532.pdf

Regarding VAT treatment: Emerald is VAT-registered in Ireland. For B2B services to non-EU establishments or where the place of supply is the customer's country, we typically issue net invoices and apply reverse charge when applicable. Our default is to leave VAT blank and include the following note: "VAT to be accounted for by the customer under the reverse charge mechanism (Article 44 VAT Directive)."

Let us know if Redwood requires us to include Irish VAT on the invoice instead — we can issue either way but prefer reverse charge when the customer is established in another EU state and accounts for VAT.

Attachment: emerald_vat_certificate_2026.pdf, emerald_invoice_sample_4532.pdf

Best regards,
Aoife Murphy
Head of Finance, Emerald Analytics Ltd
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aoife Murphy <billing@emeraldanalytics.ie>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T10:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Emerald Analytics - onboarding & VAT / invoice instructions

Hi Aoife,

Thanks for the certificate and sample invoice — that helps. A couple of notes from Finance / Tax to ensure smooth PO processing and payment: 

- For Emerald (Irish supplier) we will accept reverse charge treatment. Please omit Irish VAT on the invoice and include both your VAT number (IE6524937FH) and Redwood's EUID/VAT placeholder on the invoice (please use: GB999999999 for internal processing).
- Required invoice fields for AP: PO number (4532), invoice number, invoice date, supplier VAT number, buyer VAT/EUID placeholder, itemised net amounts, currency (EUR), and remittance instructions.
- Include the reverse-charge statement: "VAT to be accounted for by the customer under the reverse charge mechanism (Article 44 VAT Directive)."
- Please email the final PDF invoice to eu-invoices@redwood.ai and copy billing@emeraldanalytics.ie for reference.

I’ve attached a short invoice template (redwood_eu_invoice_sample.docx) showing the field mapping we use — not mandatory, but it reduces back-and-forth. Once we receive the signed PO acknowledgement and the compliant invoice, payment terms are 30 days from invoice date.

Attachment: redwood_eu_invoice_sample.docx

Thanks — happy to confirm anything else by reply.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Aoife Murphy <aoife@emeraldanalytics.ie>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Declan O'Sullivan <declan@emeraldanalytics.ie>
Date: 2026-05-06T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Emerald Analytics - onboarding & VAT / invoice instructions

Laura / Dylan — thanks for the clear notes. We have: 
- Signed PO acknowledgement attached (Signed_PO_4532.pdf).
- Final invoice attached (emerald_invoice_final_4532.pdf) with reverse-charge statement and the VAT numbers included as requested.

Quick question before we send the final remittance advice: Should the invoice include the gross amount field (VAT line left as zero) or omit the VAT line entirely? We left the VAT line present but set to 0.00 and included the reverse-charge note.

Attachment: Signed_PO_4532.pdf, emerald_invoice_final_4532.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to first payment.

Best,
Aoife Murphy
Head of Finance
Emerald Analytics Ltd
